input: {"summary":"Starting from an empty world, return exactly three operations in this order: first, fill the inclusive cuboid from (0,0,0) to (1,1,1) with stone; second, carve only the single voxel at (0,0,0), using that same coordinate for both endpoints; third, set the voxel at (3,0,0) to glass. Leave every other coordinate empty. Do not add, omit, or repeat operations. Return only the operations JSON object."}
